headline: Oura adds new cardiovascular tracking features to its smart rings
summary: Oura has added new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings, including Cardio Effort and an automatic VO2 Max estimate, as it faces growing competition from rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman in the smart ring market.

claims.statement: Oura added new cardiovascular and fitness tracking metrics to its smart rings.

sources.quote: Oura adds new fitness metrics to show how workouts impact your body
Oura adds two new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings
Oura Ring can track new stats related to cardio fitness
Oura has updated its smart rings with new cardio fitness-related metrics, including VO2 Max estimates.

claims.statement: The new features are Cardio Effort and an automatic VO2 Max estimate, formerly called Cardio Capacity.

sources.quote: Oura is introducing two new cardiovascular-focused health tracking features to its smart rings designed to help users better understand the effect regular workouts and exercise are having on their long-term health, and whether they need to ramp it up or dial things down. claims.statement: Oura faces growing competition from rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman in the smart ring market.

sources.quote: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman are emerging to dethrone it, putting pressure on the company to keep innovating. By launching more advanced workout metrics, Oura is looking to differentiate itself from competitors as the smart ring market gets more crowded.
